item.title: [ELEVATED] Acetyl fentanyl is turning up more often in Cook County's drug supply
item.description: acetylfentanyl — The Cook County Medical Examiner identified acetyl fentanyl in 13 of the 161 opioid-involved deaths it examined in the 90 days to 30 June. That is 8% of them, against 2% over the year before that. Toxicology runs about 6 weeks behind, so this describes what has been in the supply recently rather than what is in it tonight. (1 source). Aggregated from public reporting and not independently verified. Many changes in local drug supply are never publicly announced, and reporting lags reality. No alerts does not mean a safe supply.
